test_title: PYST 35: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04017d049ff6cdb33df681334a31842f47e660be79f6949b7a1dd61cfa5f7d85.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster follows the pattern +3, -4.

Let's check each option:

1. YBX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65326fa8f616066ba383f6111a8c802727203e1eea7e4157606c81dd3bc7ffd5.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern +3, -4.

2. RUQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9d1b2f4eb0ce473c4b693518c0aad9aed169e826c4a6bd7d0c922b6f77e8c52.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern +3, -4.

3. SVR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e48b9c04bc8b9cfd82c32c8a438265870e1976629c6265bae78a0295ad022b72.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern +3, -4.

4. VZU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d30d8827a481f94eaf27050c8de8b563f2cf50d2bee80a1fafa13943c061c688.png] 

This letter-cluster does not follow the pattern +3, -4.

Thus, VZU is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
